learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will become super detectives and learn how to find exactly where things are hiding!
warm_up_hook: 📖 Naughty little kitty loves to play hide and seek! Is she hiding in the box? Or is she sitting on the table? Let us learn some magic words to find her!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When something is resting inside a closed space, we say it is IN. Think of your colorful crayons resting inside your pencil box. They are warm and cozy inside!
examples: The red pencil is IN the bag.
The little fish is IN the blue water.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When something is resting right on top of another thing, we say it is ON. Think of a yummy birthday cake resting on top of a table. It is touching the top surface!
examples: The big green book is ON the desk.
The sweet apple is ON the chair.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When something is hiding below another thing, we say it is UNDER. Think of when you hide below your warm blanket to scare papa! The blanket covers you from the top.
examples: The round ball is UNDER the bed.
The lazy dog is sleeping UNDER the big tree.

practice_quiz.question: ❓ The bird is sitting right on top of the tree branch. Where is the bird?
❓ The frog jumps into the pond. The frog is now ___ the water.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Teddy Bear Detective Game
fun_activity.instructions: Take your favorite teddy bear. Make it sit IN a basket, ON a chair, and UNDER a table. Shout the magic words out loud when you do it!

chapter_summary: ⭐ IN tells us that something is hiding inside.
⭐ ON tells us that something is sitting right on top.
⭐ UNDER tells us that something is hiding below.
